simple.summary: יַחְזֵרָה (Yachzêrâh) means Jachzerah , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 9 12.

definitions.full: H3170. Yachzerah יַחְזֵרָה proper name, masculine a priest 1Chr 9:12 (for which אַחְזַי (q. v.) Neh 11:13 ), see now also Ryle on 11:13 . יְחִיָּה יְחִיאֵלִי, יְחִיאֵל, see below חיה .
